Vehicle.description: FMW (mini-CDC) overlay branch. Only the leaf datapoints below are registered with the databroker -- branches carry no state of their own (databroker/src/main.rs::read_metadata_file() calls add_entry() per leaf), so re-declaring Vehicle/Cabin/HVAC/... here does not conflict with vss_release_6.0.json when both files are passed to --vss.

Station.description: HVAC for single station in the vehicle

Row1.description: HVAC for single station in the vehicle

Driver.description: HVAC for single station in the vehicle

IsDefrosting.description: Driver-station defrost state. Non-standard FMW extension: VSS 6.0 has no defrost equivalent under Vehicle.Cabin.HVAC.* (SYS-005 section 5), so SOME/IP key 0x1009 Aircon Defrost (SYS-002 section 4.1) is exposed here. Declared as an actuator because SYS-002 lists 0x1009 in the writable key range 0x1006..0x100A, matching its sibling station nodes.
IsDefrosting.comment: Maps to CAN 0x323 Aircon byte0 bit1 (state) and CAN 0x526 AirconCommand byte3 bit1 / byte0 bit3 MM_Def_Cmd (write), per SYS-001.
